positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and maintained web applications and API web services with frameworks
such as ASP .NET and Laravel using MVC patterns.
- Debugged, generated, and tested queries, stored procedures, functions, views, DB
replications, and DB jobs on MS SQL Server.
- Developed and maintained Android and iOS mobile applications using Android Studio and Xcode.
- Built and maintained legacy software using Borland C++ and Borland Database Engine.
- Worked with various testing, project management, and integration tools such as Redmine, Jira, SOAP UI, Postman, etc.
- Managed, integrated, and customized Zoho One applications, especially Zoho CRM, to meet various business and development needs.
- Managed and maintained applications on IIS Server.
- Managed, integrated, and customized Microsoft Mail Exchange server, and Gmail SMTP server.

positions.title: Instructional Student Assistant
positions.description:
- Collected, graded, and recorded grades of students’ homework, projects, and exams for a
team of professors teaching Data Structures.
- Created homework’s solutions; reviewed, documented, and tested code; debugged version
control systems for students’ project submission and automated grading scripts.
- Worked with Travis CI, Jenkins, GitHub, Visual Studio, and Eclipse.
- Worked under minimum supervision and in a team with other student assistants, meeting
the professors once a week to give feedbacks and analysis on students’ performances.

company.name: Computer Science Department, California State University, Fullerton

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked with a software development team on website development, mobile application
development, quality assurance, and test automation.
- Designed test plans and UI tested the Skypatrol GPS Vehicle Installation Android application.
- Completed the layout design and contributed to the functionality architecture of the
company’s new application.

positions.title: Student Assistant 3
positions.description:
- Tutored college students with Mathematics from Pre-Algebra to Intermediate Algebra and Trigonometry. 
- Assisted instructors with test grading, data entry, organizing and filing students' records, and database audit. 
- Helped with technical errands such as connecting the lab's computers to the lab's printer, setting up student computers, testing learning software MyMathLab, etc.
- Trained new employees on tutoring techniques, work procedures and regulations.

projects.title: Tuffy++
projects.description:
Tuffy++ is an interactive learning Android game for children and young adults, which teaches the basics of the C++ programming language. With this game, users of all different knowledge bases can to learn the syntax, tools, functions, and paradigms associated with C++ and object-oriented programming.

Gameplay is similar to that of the popular Flappy Bird game, with the addition of the generation of a random C++ questions every time player hits an obstacle. The questions' difficulty can be adjusted to provide young learners with different levels of C++ knowledge as they immerse themselves more into the programming world.  

Tuffy++ game was developed using Java/Android with Android Studio, Adobe Photoshop, and GIMP. It is compatible with all Android 4.0+ devices.

Tuffy++ project was completed with teamwork and collaboration tools such as Google Drive, Trello Kanban, draw.io, Slack, etc.
